caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between trigger words and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance. The x-axis is labeled “cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, athletics” and is linear, spanning from an undefined starting point to “athletics” with regularly spaced tick labels corresponding to the trigger words. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” and is linear, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with tick labels at 0.6, 0.7, 0.8 and 0.9. The line representing “start” is green, marked with circles, and begins at approximately 0.73 at “cf” and increases to a peak of approximately 0.93 at “WNBA”, then declines to approximately 0.86 at “athletics”. The line representing “random” is orange, marked with crosses, and begins at approximately 0.51 at "cf", increases to approximately 0.86 at “FIFA”, and then declines back to approximately 0.77 at “athletics”. The line representing “end” is purple, marked with circles, and starts at approximately 0.62 at “cf”, increases to approximately 0.91 at “WNBA”, and decreases to approximately 0.83 at “athletics”.
